leadText:
Gavin (Japanese: ガロン Gallon) is a character of the day who appeared in From Brags to Riches. He is a Pokémon Trainer from Ganga Town, who competed in the Double Battle rounds of the Ever Grande Conference.

Gavin was facing Morrison in the Tournament. Gavin sent out his and to face off against Morrison's and . The appeared even at first, but then Gavin gained the upper hand. Morrison refused to let that get him down, however, and he soon used his Gligar's to knock out Machamp but soon after that, Marowak defeated Growlithe with .

Once again, Morrison found himself at a disadvantage when Marowak froze one of Gligar's wings with . In a seemingly desperate move, he told Gligar to charge toward Marowak. The Fly Scorpion Pokémon used and defeated Marowak. Because of his loss, Gavin was eliminated from the Ever Grande Conference.
